title: Introduce commitment-fraction-buffer and utilization-jitter reporter
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: some tenants saw intermittent utilization spikes that caused committed capacity to be consumed unpredictably during short windows. This PR introduces a lightweight commitment-fraction-buffer (an elastic fraction of a tenant's committed throughput) to absorb transient demand jitter without touching global warm pools. The buffer is sized based on short-term utilization derivatives and immutable per-commitment-window to ensure predictability. Design summary: 1) commitment-fraction-buffer controller computes a buffer fraction (0-20%) from a short sliding derivative of utilization and a configurable risk appetite per tier; 2) scale decision path is augmented to check available buffer before invoking cluster-level provisioning so short surges consume buffer rather than triggering expensive fleet resizes; 3) utilization-jitter-reporter emits a new telemetry series (util.jitter.percentile_{p}) that reports per-tenant jitter percentiles and derivative histograms for offline and realtime dashboards; 4) safety gates: minimum and maximum buffer caps, per-tenant opt-out label, and fallback to previous behavior when the buffer estimator is unhealthy. Implementation notes: new controller at pkg/autoscaler/commit_fraction_buffer.go, minor runtime scheduler hook to consult buffer in pkg/scheduler/burst_admission.go, telemetry adapters in telemetry/reporter.go, and docs + examples in docs/dedicated/commitment-buffer.md. Testing: unit tests for buffer estimator and admission gating under tests/commit_fraction_buffer_test.go; e2e scenario harness added to perf-canary to simulate 30s microbursts while asserting no extra cluster provisioning. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind ff.commit_fraction_buffer and opt-in by tenant; staged rollout: internal prod -> canary tenants -> default-on for low-risk tiers in 2 weeks. Related: touches support flow SUP-1294 (reported by infra on 2025-01-30).

release_notes: Introduce commitment-fraction-buffer to reduce transient provisioning for short tenant surges; adds util.jitter telemetry; feature flagged and opt-in per tenant.
post_deploy_notes: Monitor util.jitter.percentile_95 and util.buffer_fraction per tenant for 48h after rollout. If buffer_estimator_unhealthy alerts fire, disable ff.commit_fraction_buffer for affected tenants.
rollback_plan: Feature flag can be toggled off to revert behavior without code rollback. If rollback insufficient, revert PR and redeploy within 30 minutes.
